title: The Predictive--Optimization Gap in GuanDan Self-Play
abstract: arXiv:2610.29411v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Outcome-predictive signals are often treated as promising optimization targets in reinforcement learning, but predictive validity and optimization utility are different claims. We expose this distinction in GuanDan, a multi-round imperfect-information game in which the implication of a round outcome depends on the public match state. Held-out analysis shows that state--gain interactions provide incremental predictive value beyond a constant signed-gain effect, establishing that match progress is predictively meaningful. We then use changes in a frozen match-win predictor, $\Delta\Phi$, as a controlled round-level supervision intervention in a matched DanZero-style Monte Carlo self-play protocol. The intervention can succeed in an individual lineage: a selected progress-augmented checkpoint substantially outperforms its matched Baseline on a locked evaluation. translated_title: 掼蛋自博弈中的“预测—优化”差距
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.29411v1，公告类型：new。结果预测信号在强化学习中常被视为有前景的优化目标，但预测有效性与优化效用是两个不同的命题。我们在掼蛋——一种多回合不完全信息博弈，其中单回合结果的含义取决于公开的对局状态——中揭示了这一区别。留出集分析表明，状态—收益交互作用在恒定的带符号收益效应之外提供了额外的预测价值，证明对局进度在预测意义上是有意义的。随后，我们将冻结的对局胜负预测器的变化量 ΔΦ 作为受控的回合级监督干预手段，应用于匹配的 DanZero 风格蒙特卡洛自博弈协议中。该干预在个别训练谱系中可以成功：一个选定的进度增强检查点在锁定评估上显著优于其匹配的基线。然而，方法层面的结果逆转了这一印象：五个预注册（的实验中没有一个……）（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 在掼蛋自博弈中，对局进度虽被证明具有真实预测价值，但以冻结胜负预测器的变化 ΔΦ 作回合级监督干预，尽管在个别训练谱系中奏效，五个预注册实验在方法层面均未复现增益，揭示了预测有效性与优化效用之间的差距。
en_tdlr: In GuanDan self-play, match progress is predictively meaningful, but using ΔΦ from a frozen match-win predictor as round-level supervision—while succeeding in individual lineages—yields no method-level gains across five preregistered trials, exposing a predictive–optimization gap.
